caption: The drawing depicts a single object positioned centrally within a rectangular frame, set against a plain beige background. The object consists of three main parts: a cylindrical container at the top, a curving stem or pedestal in the middle, and a broad shallow dish at the base. The cylindrical container is black with a slight sheen and has a narrower, short upright gold or yellow cylinder protruding from its center at the top. The container rests on the flat, circular platform of the pedestal, which tapers inward and then expands again as it connects to the base. The entire pedestal and dish are also black, with shading on the right side to suggest light coming from the left. The shallow dish at the bottom is wide and circular with a slightly raised edge. The drawing uses primarily black and gray graphite or colored pencil for the object, with gold/yellow for the small top cylinder, and has no additional elements or background details within the rectangular frame.
title: Pewter Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
